body: Body source order lives in the library: hub fills named-field SubagentInput, only Subagent::new builds a Subagent (private fields, compile_fail doctest). Rejected: positional Option<&str> args or public enum the hub picks from (both let the hub reorder or swap sources).
Transcript body starts after the spawn prompt (first user text = parent Agent prompt, median 3273 chars, 212/538 over 4096). Rejected: plain render_brief of the whole subagent file.

Lag rule: a finished transcript brief is used only if it ends with the trimmed last_assistant_message when one is given, else LastMessage; unfinished brief is used only when no stop data exists (InProgress). Rejected: trusting any finished-looking brief (null stop_reason text can look final before its tool_use record is written).

Parent embedding via new render_brief_with_subagents/render_full_with_subagents; render_brief/render_full signatures and output unchanged. Rejected: filtering is_sidechain turns inside render (0 of 76 real parent files carry sidechain records; it would change the existing null_stop_reason render test).

No extraction of SubagentHandback input.message from the subagent jsonl in this task (present in 222/538 files); left as open question for TASK-015. Rejected for now: a second hidden report source that the task order does not name.

Staleness check: Transcript wins only when last_assistant_message equals the trimmed last assistant text block AND that block is the last rendered line(s) of the brief. Rejected: line-bounded suffix match on the brief (accepts "done" against a multi-line answer ending in "done").

Sidechain leak: render_brief_with_subagents/render_full_with_subagents drop every is_sidechain turn (Cow, clone only when one exists); render_brief/render_full unchanged. Rejected: filtering inside render() for all callers (changes render::null_stop_reason_falls_back_to_structure and subagent self-rendering) and a "drop only if mixed" rule (extra cleverness, no real parent has sidechain turns).

Embedded header: a known Subagent overrides the Agent line type/description field by field (Subagent value, else the call value, else agent); Subagent.agent_type becomes Option<String> so an absent type does not mask the call subagent_type. Rejected: always using Subagent::render header (drops the call description when meta is missing, breaks sidechain_fixture test expectation).

Shared CARGO_TARGET_DIR across two copies of the workspace (ws, mut_ws) gave stale results: cargo hashes path packages by workspace-relative path, so both copies share artifact names and mtime freshness reused the other copy build (adversarial test reported 3 FAILED on fixed code). Fix: unique target dir per tree; PLAN_FINAL mandates a fresh implementer target dir.

QA oracle for 'render_brief/render_full unchanged': git archive of main's crates/transcript renamed transcript_main in %TEMP%, compared byte for byte with HEAD on all fixtures and 76 real parents (identical). Rejected: trusting tests/render.rs alone (it only covers fixture strings).
